name: University of Toronto
overview: Canada's highest-ranked university. Course-based professional master's degrees are considerably more expensive than thesis-based research master's, so the programme type matters more than the institution when budgeting.

name: University of British Columbia
overview: Research master's tuition at UBC is unusually low for North America and is quoted per year rather than per credit, which makes a thesis-based MSc one of the more affordable routes into Canada.

name: McGill University
overview: An English-medium university in francophone Montreal, where living costs are markedly lower than Toronto or Vancouver. Quebec sets its own international fee schedule.

name: University of Waterloo
overview: Known for co-operative education, which alternates study terms with paid work terms and can offset a substantial share of tuition. Particularly strong in computing and engineering.

name: University of Alberta
overview: A research-intensive university with comparatively moderate tuition and living costs, strong in engineering, energy and agriculture.

name: University of Melbourne
overview: Australia's leading research university. International tuition is high and is charged per year of a two-year master's, so the full-course cost is roughly double the annual figure.

name: UNSW Sydney
overview: A large engineering and business-focused university running three terms a year, which allows some master's degrees to be completed in under two years.

name: Monash University
overview: Australia's largest university, with campuses in Malaysia and elsewhere that allow part of a degree to be taken at lower cost before transferring.

name: University of Queensland
overview: A research-intensive university in Brisbane, where living costs are lower than Sydney or Melbourne while tuition remains comparable.

name: University of Sydney
overview: Australia's oldest university, with a broad postgraduate catalogue. Sydney has the highest living costs of any Australian study destination.

name: Seoul National University
overview: Korea's leading national university. Tuition is modest by OECD standards and a large share of international graduate students hold either a Korean Government Scholarship or a departmental waiver.

name: KAIST
overview: A science and technology institute where admitted graduate students are generally supported by a full tuition waiver plus a stipend, making the real cost of attendance close to zero for strong applicants.

name: Yonsei University
overview: A private university with an extensive English-taught graduate catalogue and a long history of admitting international students.

name: Korea University
overview: One of Korea's three most selective universities, strong in business, law and engineering, with a large English-medium offering.

name: POSTECH
overview: A small, highly selective research institute where graduate admission normally carries full funding. Research-intensive rather than broad.

name: University of Malaya
overview: Malaysia's oldest and highest-ranked university. Tuition and living costs are a fraction of Western destinations and English is widely used in teaching.

name: Universiti Putra Malaysia
overview: A public research university with particular strength in agriculture, food science, veterinary medicine and forestry - fields directly relevant to Bangladesh.

name: Universiti Teknologi Malaysia
overview: An engineering-focused public university with low tuition and a large South Asian student community.

name: Monash University Malaysia
overview: A full branch campus awarding the same Australian degree as Monash in Melbourne at substantially lower tuition and living cost, with the option of transferring to Australia mid-degree.

name: Trinity College Dublin
overview: Ireland's oldest and highest-ranked university. Non-EU tuition is set per programme and Dublin accommodation is scarce and expensive - apply for housing early.

name: University College Dublin
overview: Ireland's largest university, with a broad taught-master's catalogue and a one-year structure that lowers the total cost of a master's relative to two-year systems.

name: University of Galway
overview: A mid-sized university on the Atlantic coast with notably lower living costs than Dublin and strengths in medical technology and informatics.

name: University College Cork
overview: A research university in Ireland's second city, with lower accommodation costs than Dublin and a strong food science and pharmaceutical sector nearby.

name: Dublin City University
overview: A younger, industry-oriented university with established work-placement routes in computing and business.
